Periapical granuloma: No tenderness on percussion of the involved teeth
2-month history of slowly growing, dull, intermittent swelling and discomfort in the right upper vestibule
fluctuations in pain intensity and a sensation of heaviness in the area
Firm, mildly tender diffuse swelling of the adjacent vestibular mucosa
Panoramic radiography demonstrated a mild periapical radiolucency at the affected root apices
Curettage yielded a gelatinous, soft, mushy tissue
Provisional diagnosis after extraction and curettage: periapical granuloma
